rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: PrismHR is a community MCP server that connects AI agents to PrismHR's HR platform, exposing payroll processing, benefits administration, billing, and compliance tools. It uses FastMCP with async httpx and Pydantic, includes a deny-default permission system, and supports 1Password CLI for secure credential management. Not affiliated with PrismHR. Requires Python 3.10+.
